exact_statement: For all finite disjoint uniform blocks X,Z, Boolean g(X), indicators A(X),B(X), and two fixed subcube indicators p(Z),q(Z) with arbitrary fixed-coordinate sets and assignments, put E=(Ap) XOR (Bq) or E=(Ap) OR (Bq), F=g(-1)^E. Assume P_Z(E(x,Z))<=1/4 for every x. With I_X,I_Z belonging to final F and Q_access=H(F)-E_Z H(F_Z), Q_access<=K I_Z+2I_X, K=4+log2(5)+2/ln(2)<19/2. Compatible assignments permit K=6+2/ln(2)<9. After contracting controls outside the two fixed sets, one row-independent normalized complete reference on every nonempty control subset uses at most five flat cells (four when compatible) with log-cardinality<=twice conditional mean degree. The combined final mask owns the core reserve once. Every actual core entropy is retained. If every actual F_z satisfies U(F_z)<=bI(F_z), b>=0, then H(F)<=K I_Z+(4+2b)I_X<=max(K,4+2b)I(F). In particular all actual cores of Fourier degree at most two give H(F)<=K I(F), with unbounded controller widths. No arbitrary core admission or arbitrary control-dependent seed is asserted.
